description: This Java source file defines an interface `ReconnectConfig` and nested interfaces/enums for configuration settings related to reconnection behavior in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity service. It provides method signatures for retrieving reconnect delay durations, journal batch size, and rate configurations, along with enum definitions for default values and configuration paths.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve reconnect configuration settings.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig.ReconnectConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining default configuration path expressions and default values for reconnect settings.

classes.name: ReconnectConfig.RateConfig
classes.description: Nested interface defining rate limit configuration settings for recovery throttling.

classes.name: RateConfig.RateConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining default configuration path expressions and default values for rate limiting settings.

methods.name: getInitialDelay
methods.description: Returns the initial delay duration for reconnection after the actor has started.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for trying to reconnect all started connections.

methods.name: getReadJournalBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the number of events to read from the journal in one batch.

methods.name: getRateConfig
methods.description: Returns the RateConfig object for recovery throttling configuration.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Within RateConfig, returns the frequency duration of recovery.

methods.name: getEntityAmount
methods.description: Returns the number of entities to recover per batch.
